thread:
hana: FYI onboarding kikyo-v2 q4a produced a weird detok/RTL mixup on a few ja/zh + ar samples. low-volume but reproducible in CI :confused:
pablo: can you drop a failing example?
hana: minimal repro (float32 vs q4a detok):
```
src (ja): 
# real example: 
float32: 今日は（きょう）いい天気ですね。
q4a: 今日は（きょういい天気ですね。
```
meera: missing closing paren again, but also saw cases where ZWJ made katakana glue to preceding hanzi. any token id diffs?
hana: dumped ids quickly from CI run:
```
float32 ids: [1200, 88, 502, 77, 230]
q4a ids:    [1200, 88, 50277, 230]
# token 77 merged into 50277 in quantized decode
```
zhi: that format of id concat looks like an integer concatenation bug rather than offset; could be snprintf-style sprintf used somewhere in debug path mixing up buffers.
ci-bot: CI artifacts: build 2769990002 attached (model sha: abc123, runtime: q4a-runtime@v2). chrF delta ja->en: -1.9, zh->en: -2.2, ar->en: -1.1. throughput +3.8x.
pablo: do tokenizer-only outputs match float32? if yes then runtime/decoder is culprit.
hana: tokenizer-only reproduces float32. so it's downstream. reproducible with --decode-dump-ids: decode shows fused_lookup returning 50277 at step 4.
meera: also note we saw an RTL case where arabic closing bracket ) got mirrored incorrectly and attached:
```
src (ar): اليوم (الاجتماع) في المساء.
float32: Today (the meeting) is in the evening.
q4a: Today (the meeting is in the evening.
```
zhi: looks like either the glyph mirroring step or the punctuation handling in the decoder changed when using packed logits. Could be UTF-8 boundary handling when writing to a temporary buffer.
ops-bot: Suggested mitigation: route ja/zh/ar to kikyo-v2-fp32 for 2 hours while we triage, alert if >0.5% request errors.
pablo: plan: 1) instrument fused_lookup to log raw index vectors before and after packing; 2) git-bisect runtime commits touching vocab_pack/fused_lookup; 3) add punctuation-heavy CJK/RTL samples to regression suite and mark q4a builds quarantined.
hana: I've opened ticket ML-4721 and attached failing samples + CI reproducer. assigning to @pablo @meera.
meera: I'll start the bisect later today and prep a small harness to repro exact decode ordering on CI image. if we need infra help to run on same GPU HW I'll ping @ops.
pablo: thanks — also add a short e2e smoke test that detoks and compares token ids for ja/zh/ar to catch integer-concat issues early.
hana: will do. updating thread with bisect link once available. :white_check_mark:
